Subject: Change order request - additional dedicated capacity & SOW tweak

Jordan — following up on last week's call. Holocene's pilot is trending ahead of forecast and you're bumping into the committed throughput by mid-month. As discussed, we can: 

- Add a dedicated pool of 8xA100-equivalent slots for the remainder of Q2 (starts 2026-05-01)
- Shift the implementation SOW Deliverable B (integration validation) to a short parallel track so your team can run the new models earlier

Attached is a draft change order and an updated Order Form (OrderForm_v3) with the new tiered price and rebate language. High-level commercial change: an incremental monthly commitment of $55k for the dedicated pool with a one-time implementation uplift of $12k.

Can you confirm the commercial approach and whether your legal team will redline the doc? If helpful, Ben and I can jump on a 30-min legal sync to run through the specific clauses (billing proration, early-termination credits, and data isolation notes).

Next steps suggested: 
- You confirm acceptance of capacity and go/no-go on the accelerated SOW track by EOD Mon (4/12)
- Legal returns redlines to camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Thanks —
Camila

Camila — thanks for the quick follow. The capacity proposal looks reasonable, and the timeline to start on 5/1 works from our side. Our procurement flagged the implementation uplift and asked for a brief justification memo for the extra $12k (standard internal review).

I've looped in legal (they'll send formal redlines). Please expect our redline packet tomorrow; we may ask for: 
- clarification on the proration approach if we ramp mid-month
- a short SLA carveout for the accelerated SOW track (we want a rollback path if integration blocks appear)

I'll also try to get procurement's memo prepped today so we can speed approvals.

—Jordan

Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Holocene - Redlines to Change Order and Order Form (v3)

Camila — we've reviewed OrderForm_v3 and the proposed change order. Attached is a redline PDF with inline comments (Holocene-Change-Order-Redline_20260410.pdf). Primary asks: 

1) Proration: insist on pro-rata billing when capacity is added mid-billing period; we propose a per-hour proration formula rather than full-month billing.
2) SLA carveout: request a narrow rollback right (30 days) for the accelerated SOW track if integration causes production instability.
3) Data isolation: confirm that customer data from the pilot will reside in a dedicated namespace and not be used for other customer cache layers.

We are open to a firm-level compromise for a one-time credit if Redwood provides a limited proof-of-performance window.

Please advise who on your side will handle the legal-to-legal redline call.

Thanks,
Clara Mendes
Senior Counsel | Holocene AI

Subject: Re: Holocene - Redlines to Change Order and Order Form (v3)

Hi Clara / Jordan — thanks for the redlines. Quick operational answers up front: 

- Proration: we support a proration approach. Redwood proposes daily proration using the same billing unit as the invoice period (we can provide the formula). If you prefer per-hour, we can accommodate with a short note in the change order.
- SLA carveout: we cannot accept a 30-day unilateral rollback right without a paired remediation plan. Proposal: a 14-day accelerated integration window with an agreed rollback trigger (error-rate > 3% or >80% increased tail latency for the integration path), escalation to engineering, and a one-time partial credit if rollback is invoked.
- Data isolation: confirmed — the pilot data will be provisioned in a dedicated namespace and we will not include that data in cross-customer caching. We'll add precise language to the appendix.

Camila / Karthik — can we schedule a 30-min legal sync Wed 4/14 at 10:00 PT to walk through Clara's redlines and finalize language? I'll bring the proration formula and the rollback trigger draft.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
